channel.title: Oceanfront Property Hunt
channel.desc: Ashleigh met her husband Rob while traveling in England, and their shared love of adventure soon brought them to Canada's West Coast to start a family. But for these passionate surfers, life by the ocean has always been just out of reach. Now, they're taking a big leap across the country to Nova Scotia, hoping to finally live steps from the waves and closer to Rob's family in England.
